title: Research & Data Analyst
description:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

Job Purpose

This role plays a key part in supporting Legal 500’s strategic growth by expanding lawyer-led coverage into focus markets. Research & Data Analysts work closely with the City Elite editor and relevant commercial team members to identify a target number of new firms and lawyers per market.

This is a results-driven position that requires a proactive, self-motivated approach and requires individuals to engage in direct client outreach to generate leads. This includes managing tailored email campaigns and conducting interviews to gather insights and build relationships with partner-level lawyers.

 

What we're looking for

The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, who is results-driven, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. This is an entry-level role, so no previous commercial experience is required. That said, any experience in the below would be desirable:

  • Background in customer/client care

  • Background in a telephone role

  • Exposure to market research, publishing, insight generation, or similar project-based industries

  • Strong research skills

  • Background of working both independently and in a team

 

From a competency-perspective, we're looking for someone who fits the following:

  • Excellent communicator: engages clearly with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Interpersonal skills: exceptional phone manner and comfortable speaking with law firm partners and business development professionals daily

  • Relationship builder: ability to develop and maintain strong professional relationships internally and externally; credible and approachable particularly with law firm BDs and partners

  • Results-oriented: maintains momentum and motivation across competing deadlines

  • Organised and detail-oriented: ensures research output meets accuracy and consistency standards

  • Flexible mindset: ability to be adaptable and agile to changing priorities and market interest and contribute to workflow development where appropriate

  • Strong time management skills: ability to manage and prioritise own workload to ensure projects meet deadlines

  • Curious mindset: while an interest in the legal market is not a prerequisite, candidates would be expected to quickly expand their legal market knowledge.

 

Other information

  • The location is Aire Street, Leeds

  • This role will be hybrid, 3 days a week in the office in central Leeds, 2 days remote

  • Working hours vary between 9am - 5pm and 11am to 7pm depending upon projects and business needs. (Due to this role working with US-based stakeholders, therefore the working hours will have some crossover with US timezones)

  • Salary - £29000 per annum

title: Data Analyst (EN)
description:
Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact!

At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome.

What will you do?

Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied.

Product

In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work.

  • Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition;

  • Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working;

  • Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts;

  • Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them;

  • Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development;

  • Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company.

Commercial & marketing support

Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex.

  • Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities;

  • Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS.

This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact.

Your team

You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data.

The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst;

  • Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics;

  • Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude;

  • Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it;

  • Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter;

  • Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders;

  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues;

  • Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus);

We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them.

What do we offer?

  • A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more;

  • A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy;

  • One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in;

  • A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions;

  • A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility.

YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) - Finance
description:
Du willst Anforderungen nicht nur aufnehmen, sondern verstehen, was wirklich dahintersteckt? Du möchtest Softwarelösungen mitgestalten und dabei Business und Entwicklung zusammenbringen? Dann bring Dich bei uns ein – in Kundenprojekten für Banken, Versicherungen und Unternehmen aus dem Handel sowie beim Aufbau unseres Standorts in Hannover.

Aufgaben

  • Von der Fragestellung zum eigentlichen Bedarf: Du hinterfragst, analysierst und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich zählen. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Stakeholdern setzt Du klare Prioritäten und schaffst die Grundlage für passende Softwarelösungen.

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Geschäftslogik in technische Spezifikationen. Als Bindeglied zur Softwareentwicklung sorgst Du dafür, dass fachliche Ziele und technische Umsetzung zusammenpassen.

  • Du visualisierst Prozesse, Entscheidungslogiken und Systemzusammenhänge mit BPMN, DMN oder UML. So schaffst Du ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung.

  • Du setzt Jira, Confluence und weitere Werkzeuge aus dem Atlassian-Ökosystem gezielt ein, um Anforderungen nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren und die Projektarbeit zu unterstützen.

  • Je nach Projektkontext übernimmst Du auch die Product-Owner-Rolle und bringst Deine analytische Perspektive in die Steuerung der Produktentwicklung ein.

  • Du wirkst am Aufbau unseres neuen Standorts mit, bringst Ideen für Strukturen und Zusammenarbeit ein und gestaltest das Miteinander vor Ort.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Business-Analyse für Softwareprojekte mit, idealerweise im Consulting. Anforderungsanalyse und Prozessmodellierung mit BPMN, DMN oder UML gehören zu Deinem Handwerkszeug.

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in umsetzbare Spezifikationen und kennst die Arbeit mit agilen Entwicklungsteams, Jira und Confluence. Product-Owner-Erfahrung ist ein Plus.

  • Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, moderierst Workshops und bringst Fachbereich und Entwicklung zu einem gemeinsamen Verständnis – auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen.

  • Du möchtest unseren Standort in Hannover aktiv mitgestalten. Für den Senior-Einstieg bringst Du zusätzlich Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Begleitung komplexer Vorhaben mit und teilst Dein Wissen gerne im Team.


Benefits

  • Great Place To Work

  • Regionalität und kurze Wege

  • Flexibilität und Pragmatismus

  • Weiterbildung und geförderte persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen, dich fachlich weiterentwickeln und Teil eines engagierten Teams werden möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Du hast zunächst Fragen? Dann melde dich per Mail oder rufe mich gerne an, dann besprechen wir die Details dazu: 0221 6700 2181

Ich würde mich sehr freuen.

title: Working Student - Business Analyst, Growth & Operations (m/f/d) – Dutch Market
Business Analyst Processes and Data
description:
For a renowned Swiss bank in Zurich, we are looking for an experienced business analyst. You analyse processes, data flows and systems in customer and contract management or in real estate management, and derive target pictures and decision bases from them.

Your tasks

  1. Analyse and document processes, data flows, systems and responsibilities end to end

  2. Create the as-is analysis, derive the target picture and to-be processes, define data ownership

  3. Assess optimisation potential in data storage and the system landscape

  4. Create business cases, effort estimates and risk analyses

  5. Moderate workshops and present results at management level

Your profile

  1. German at C2 level, the project language is German. Understanding of Swiss German is expected

  2. Several years as a business analyst or data analyst in banking or comparable industries

  3. Process and data analysis with BPMN, UML and visualisation tools

  4. Understanding of IT architecture, system landscapes, interfaces and data flows

  5. Confident use of Excel, PowerPoint, Jira and Confluence

Nice to have

  1. Customer and contract management, Siebel CRM

  2. Practical experience with AI tools in business analysis

  3. Power BI or Tableau, basic knowledge of CAFM and ERP
